_meta.title: Country-specific guidance for foreign tourists in India
_meta.note: Generic, verifiable guidance (Indian immigration/registration rules apply the same way regardless of nationality) plus each country's own helpline language, per the Ministry of Tourism's 1363 tourist helpline. Not legal advice.

_default.visa_overstay_note: Overstaying a visa in India is a legal violation handled by the FRRO/FRO (Foreigners Regional Registration Office); penalties and exit procedures depend on how long the overstay was and whether it was voluntary. Contact your nearest FRRO before your visa expires, not after.
common_scams: Unofficial 'travel agents' near stations/airports claiming your hotel is closed or full
Gem/carpet 'export scheme' offers promising huge resale profits
Overcharging on unmetered taxis/autos -- always confirm the fare or insist on the meter/app
cultural_notes: Dress modestly at religious sites; footwear is usually removed before entering
Public displays of affection are less common and can draw unwanted attention
Tipping (10%) is customary but not obligatory in restaurants
police_reporting_steps: Call 112 (India's national emergency number) or 100 for police
File an FIR (First Information Report) at the nearest police station for theft/loss -- required for insurance claims and replacement travel documents
For a lost passport, also contact your embassy/consulate immediately
